mapper.select: SELECT sys_user_tenant.tenant_id FROM sys_user_tenant sys_user_tenant WHERE sys_user_tenant.user_id = #{userId} AND sys_user_tenant.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sys_user_tenant.is_default DESC
SELECT sut.user_id AS "userId", sut.tenant_id AS "tenantId" FROM sys_user_tenant sut WHERE sut.del_flag = '0' AND sut.user_id IN #{uid} ORDER BY sut.user_id, sut.is_default DESC
